correctness.rationale: For every k>=1, domino tilings of P2 square P_{2k} begin with the first rung or the first horizontal pair, giving X_n=U_n cup V_n with two nonempty cones and exact intersection X_{n-2}. The blockwise subcomplex Y_k=*_{j=1}^k (Delta(A_j) disjoint union Delta(B_j)) has the same two-cone decomposition and an intersection Y_{k-1}->X_{2k-2}. From the exact k=1 base, the CW gluing lemma inductively shows the inclusion Y_k->X_{2k} is an ordinary homotopy equivalence. Each pair of edge-simplices deforms equivariantly to its two component barycenters; their join is an invariant S^{k-1}. Row swap fixes component labels and reverses internal edge order only, leaving each barycenter fixed, hence acts +1 on top homology; column reversal permutes k join factors in reverse order, degree (-1)^{k(k-1)/2}. Rational coinvariants under the Klein four action yield the quotient condition k=0,1 mod4. Independent enumeration from the tiling recursion for 2,4,6 columns and oriented simplicial Lefschetz signs matches all four involutions; finite cases do not replace the gluing induction.
residual_risks: Finite tests provide corroboration only; the claimed uniform or asymptotic theorem relies on the inspected analytical proof.
